entities.summary: Tafsīr al-Baghawī, also known as Ma‘ālim al-Tanzīl, is a classical Sunni tafsir by Husayn b. Mas'ūd al-Baghawī, written as an abridgement of Tafsir al-Thalabi by al-Tha'labī. It is generally classified as one of the books of narration-based tafsir, as it collects and presents many statements from the Sahabah and Tabi'oon. The book primarily relies on 11 reliable chains of narrations, which al-Baghawi mentions in the introduction to his work. It currently exists in four volumes and eight volumes in its Lebanon edition and Cairo edition respectively.
